name: Shell Execution Allowlist & Sanitizer
description: Implement isCommandSafe in src/command-filter.ts to block destructive shell commands like rm -rf, fork bombs, and piping curl to bash.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement isCommandSafe(cmd: string): boolean in src/command-filter.ts. Allow safe development commands (git, bun, npm, tsc). Block destructive commands ('rm -rf', 'curl ... | bash', 'mkfs', ':(){ :|:& };:'). Ensure test/command-filter.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: isCommandSafe allows git, bun, npm, tsc commands
isCommandSafe blocks rm -rf, piped curl to bash, and fork bombs
